categories.description: Questions about the outcome of a single game or a playoff series between two named teams or individuals. Covers professional and college sports across all leagues.
summarized_patterns: which of two named teams wins a single game
which team wins a best-of-N playoff series
individual athletic competition winner
examples: Which professional football team, Buffalo or New England, will win the game scheduled for Oct 5, 2025?
Which college football team, Kansas St. or TCU, will win the game scheduled for Oct 11, 2025?
Which professional baseball team, Philadelphia or Los Angeles D, will win the best-of-five series that begins on October 04, 2025?

subcategories.description: Predict the winner of a single game between two named teams. Applies to professional and college sports (NFL, MLB, MLS, WNBA, college football, etc.).
summarized_patterns: professional team sports single game winner
college team sports single game winner
head-to-head team matchup in any sport
examples: Which professional football team, Jacksonville or Kansas City, will win the game scheduled for Oct 6, 2025?
Which college football team, Utah or Arizona St., will win the game scheduled for Oct 11, 2025?
Which professional women's basketball team, Las Vegas or Phoenix, will win the Game 3 matchup scheduled for Oct 8, 2025?
Which professional MLS soccer team, Miami or Atlanta, will win the game scheduled for Jun 28, 2025?

subcategories.description: Predict which team wins a multi-game playoff series (best-of-5, best-of-7, etc.) rather than a single game.
summarized_patterns: which team wins a best-of-N playoff series
series winner across multiple games
overall series outcome in professional sports playoffs
examples: Which professional baseball team, Philadelphia or Los Angeles D, will win the best-of-five series between Philadelphia and Los Angeles D?
Which team, Los Angeles D or Philadelphia, will win the Los Angeles D vs Philadelphia series in the 2025 professional baseball playoffs?
Which professional baseball team, Detroit or Seattle, will win the Detroit vs Seattle series in the 2025 professional baseball playoffs?

subcategories.description: Predict the winner of an individual athletic competition such as a golf tournament, race, or other solo-participant event.
summarized_patterns: golf or individual sport tournament winner
winner chosen from a field of named participants
individual competition outcome
examples: Baycurrent Classic Winner?

categories.description: Questions asking which of several named options wins an overall competition, season championship, award, or political nomination. One outcome is selected from a labeled set.
summarized_patterns: which team wins a season championship
who wins a political primary or nomination
which named option wins an award or title
examples: Pro Women's Basketball Champion?
Who will be the Republican nominee for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District (TN-7) for the 2025 U.S. House election?

subcategories.description: Predict which team or individual wins an overall season championship or named tournament with multiple competing options.
summarized_patterns: season champion from a set of named teams
overall competition winner from a labeled field
which option wins the title
examples: Pro Women's Basketball Champion?
Baycurrent Classic Winner? (field of named golfers)

subcategories.description: Predict who wins a political primary, nomination, or election from a set of named candidates.
summarized_patterns: party primary nominee outcome
election winner from named candidates
political nomination result
examples: Who will be the Republican nominee for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District (TN-7) for the 2025 U.S. House election?

categories.description: Questions about chart positions, numeric sales or stream totals, or whether content exceeds a popularity or engagement threshold.
summarized_patterns: which release will be #1 on a named chart
how many streams or sales will a release accumulate
will a piece of content exceed a view or engagement threshold
examples: Which album will be #1 on the Billboard Top 200 chart dated Oct 11, 2025?
What will be the total number of Spotify streams for Taylor Swift's song 'The Fate of Ophelia' by Oct 10, 2025?
Will any MrBeast video uploaded in September 2025 receive more than 100 million views seven days after its upload?

subcategories.description: Predict which specific item occupies a named chart position (e.g., #1 on Billboard) on a given date.
summarized_patterns: number one position on a named chart
top chart rank on a specific date
which release leads the chart
examples: Which album will be #1 on the Billboard Top 200 chart dated Oct 11, 2025?

subcategories.description: Predict the exact or banded numeric count of sales, streams, or chart units for a release within a specified time window.
summarized_patterns: total Spotify stream count by a deadline
reported album sales on a chart date
numeric volume of plays or purchases
examples: What will be the total number of Spotify streams for 'The Life of a Showgirl (feat. Sabrina Carpenter)' by Oct 10, 2025?
What will be the reported album sales for 'The Life of a Showgirl' on the Hits Daily Double Top 50 Chart dated October 10, 2025?

subcategories.description: Binary prediction of whether a piece of content (video, post, etc.) will exceed a specified view, like, or engagement count by a deadline.
summarized_patterns: will a video exceed a view count threshold
binary engagement milestone prediction
will content reach a specified audience size
examples: Will any MrBeast video uploaded in September 2025 receive more than 100 million views seven days after its upload, before Oct 1, 2025?

categories.description: Questions about whether a specific word or phrase will be said, or what topic or quote a named person will express, during a scheduled public event, broadcast, podcast, or earnings call.
summarized_patterns: will a named person say a specific word or phrase at an event
what topic or statement will someone make during a public appearance
keyword mention in a broadcast, podcast, or earnings call
examples: Will Sam Altman say the word 'AGI' during the TBPN Podcast on October 10th?
What will Alex Cooper say during the next Call Her Daddy Podcast?
Will any PepsiCo representative say the word 'Tariff' during PepsiCo's next earnings call?

subcategories.description: Binary prediction of whether a specific keyword or phrase will be uttered by a named person (or anyone present) during a scheduled event, show, podcast, or corporate call.
summarized_patterns: will a specific word be said during a named event
binary keyword mention in a broadcast or podcast
phrase utterance prediction in earnings calls or public appearances
examples: Will Sam Altman say the word 'AGI' during the TBPN Podcast on October 10th?
Will Taylor Swift say 'Engage' or 'Engaged' on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon?
Will Jeff Probst say the word 'Puzzle' during Survivor Season 49 Episode 3?
Will any PepsiCo representative say the word 'Tariff' during PepsiCo's next earnings call?
Will any CEO say the word 'Antifa' during the House Oversight Committee hearing?

subcategories.description: Multi-option prediction of what topic, statement, or quoted language a named person will express during a public appearance. The outcome is selected from a labeled set of possible topics.
summarized_patterns: what topic will someone discuss during a podcast or interview
which phrase or subject will be the focus of a public appearance
what will announcers or hosts say during a broadcast
examples: What will Alex Cooper say during the next Call Her Daddy Podcast?
What will Taylor Swift say during Late Night With Seth Meyers?
What will the announcers say during the Kansas City at Jacksonville Pro football game?
What will the announcers say during the Philadelphia at New York pro football game?

categories.description: Questions about the outcome of a named legal case, including which party will be found liable, whether charges will be filed, or the resolution of a named lawsuit.
summarized_patterns: which party will be held liable in a named lawsuit
legal case resolution or verdict
outcome of litigation between named parties
examples: Which party, Drake or Universal Music Group (UMG), will be held liable in the lawsuit between Drake and UMG by Dec 31, 2026?

subcategories.description: Predict which party will be found liable, or what the verdict will be, in a named lawsuit or legal dispute.
summarized_patterns: which party wins or is held liable in a lawsuit
named legal case outcome
verdict or settlement prediction
examples: Which party, Drake or Universal Music Group (UMG), will be held liable in the lawsuit between Drake and UMG by Dec 31, 2026?

categories.description: Questions about the outcome of a reality TV competition episode, specifically who will be eliminated or voted out.
summarized_patterns: which participant will be eliminated in a reality TV episode
who gets voted out in a named competition show
reality competition elimination outcome
examples: Which participants will be officially eliminated in Episode 3 of Survivor Season 49?

subcategories.description: Predict which named participant(s) will be eliminated or voted out in a specific episode of a reality competition show.
summarized_patterns: who is eliminated in a named episode of a competition show
voted-out participant in a reality TV show
reality show episode elimination result
examples: Which participants will be officially eliminated in Episode 3 of Survivor Season 49?

categories.description: Questions that cannot be meaningfully forecast because they are missing key information such as event description, resolution criteria, time window, or outcome definitions.
summarized_patterns: question missing event description or resolution date
outcome labels with no domain context
forecasting prompt too vague to answer without clarification
examples: Insufficient date/time information in provided rules/raw to create a fully specified event.

subcategories.description: Questions that are structurally incomplete — missing the event, domain, resolution date, or outcome definitions needed to produce a calibrated forecast.
summarized_patterns: no event description or resolution date provided
malformed or placeholder question
cannot be forecasted without requester clarification
examples: Insufficient date/time information in provided rules/raw to create a fully specified event.
